summary: The bill establishes a rotating panel of 13 circuit judges that reviews every petition for a writ of certiorari, grants it only if at least four judges find it meets listed conflict or importance criteria, and forwards granted cases to the Supreme Court for argument.

The bill addresses only Supreme Court procedures and contains no tax-related provisions.
